reuse.why: Reuses isTrackingBudget, getCategoryAverage, setNMonthAvg and extractTagsFromText from shared/tags for the #fixed check, and every month-wide action filters through the new isMonthFillCategory.

duplication.why: The category SELECT (hidden, group_hidden, has_template, group note join) is written three times: in getBudgetData, inline in setZero, and in getSpendingFillCategories, the latter two differing only by LEFT vs INNER JOIN.

placement.why: The selection predicate, the sign helper and the new action all live in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions, and the method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the month-wide actions, their registration and tests.

maintainability.why: The rule is one predicate with explicit options, but the column list feeding it is spread across three queries, every caller computes isTracking itself, and getAverageBudgetAmount is also used for last-month spending under an average-specific name.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setZero in budget/actions.ts writes its own copy of the category query instead of going through getSpendingFillCategories (preserving the group-join difference by a separate query rather than a parameter).

disguised_duplication.where: setZero's inline query and getSpendingFillCategories are the same SELECT reshaped only by the join type, and getBudgetData repeats the same derived columns (has_template, group_note join).

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthFillCategory gains the includeHiddenCategories option and a flag-gated hidden branch; setZero keeps its own category query beside getSpendingFillCategories.
